info.title: 101 App API
info.description: REST API of the 101 app (projects, tasks, notifications, accounts). Authentication is cookie based: call `POST /auth/login` and the session cookie is sent automatically on subsequent requests.

cookieAuth.name: session_token
cookieAuth.description: Session token set by `POST /auth/login` (cookie name configurable via AUTH_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME).

code.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT or INTERNAL_ERROR

description.description: Trimmed; empty or missing is stored as null
Trimmed; empty or missing is stored as null

deadline.description: Any date string parseable by `new Date()`; empty or missing is stored as null

get.description: Orphaned tasks from before projects existed (not owned by any user).

post.summary: Copy a legacy task into a project
post.description: Creates a new task in the given project from the legacy task (title and status are taken from the legacy task).

description.description: Trimmed; empty or missing is stored as null

deadline.description: Empty or missing is stored as null

200.description: Task created from the legacy task

404.description: Legacy task or project not found

patch.description: Assign a task to a project member (or unassign it with `assignedUserId: null`). The assignee must be the project's owner or a member.

400.description: Request validation failed, or assignee is not the project owner or a member

get.description: Projects the authenticated user owns or is a member of.

post.description: The authenticated user becomes the owner.

403.description: Only the project owner can update it
Only the project owner can delete it

delete.summary: Remove a member from a project

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: User ID of the member to remove

403.description: Only the project owner can remove members

404.description: Project not found, or user is not a member

post.description: Leave a project as a member. Not available to the project owner, who must transfer ownership or delete the project instead. Any task assigned to the leaving member within this project is unassigned as part of the same operation.

403.description: The project owner cannot leave the project

404.description: Project not found, or not a member

post.summary: Transfer project ownership to a member
post.description: Owner only. The designated member becomes the owner and the previous owner becomes a regular member, in a single transaction. The new owner is notified asynchronously.

identifier.description: Email or username of the member who becomes the owner

403.description: Only the project owner can transfer ownership

404.description: Project not found, or no user with this email or username

409.description: The user already owns the project, is not a member of it, or ownership or membership changed concurrently

post.summary: Send a join request to a user
post.description: Owner only. The user is not added to the project until they accept.

identifier.description: Email or username of the user to invite

403.description: Only the project owner can send join requests

404.description: Project not found, or no user with this email or username

409.description: User is already a member, already the owner, or already has a pending request

get.summary: List the join requests sent for a project
get.description: Owner only. All statuses, most recent first.

403.description: Only the project owner can view join requests

get.summary: List the current user's own pending join requests

200.description: Join request accepted and membership created

404.description: Join request not found, or not addressed to this user
Join request not found, or not addressed to this user

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's notifications, most recent first

post.summary: Log in and start a session
post.description: On success, sets an httpOnly `session_token` cookie used to authenticate subsequent requests.
Invalidates the current session, if any, and clears the session cookie. Always succeeds, even without a valid session.

patch.description: At least one of username, email or newPassword must be provided. currentPassword is required when changing email or password.

currentPassword.description: Required when changing email or password

confirmNewPassword.description: Must match newPassword when newPassword is set

post.description: This does not delete the account immediately: it records the request for processing and freezes the account (all sessions, including the current one, are invalidated).

409.description: A deletion request is already pending
